svg.text: Each isolation layer is also a log source — the SIEM is what turns three silent gates into one visible story
A packet with the wrong VLAN tag
segment is a real signal — an IDS
— OSS: Suricata per VLAN; AWS: GuardDuty
anomalous syscall — OSS: Falco; AWS: GuardDuty
same workspace_id / owner attribution across all three sources —
One risk-ranked incident: "workspace X — proxy denial, then a VLAN-102 IDS hit,
then an anomalous syscall in the same sandbox, within 3 seconds"
